description: This file provides utility functions for mapping status strings and arbitrary strings to consistent color values, primarily for use in UI elements to indicate status or categories in a dark-themed dashboard.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-hued HSL color string from an input string, ensuring unique colors for different strings.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme color, falling back to a deterministic color if the status is unknown. Supports known statuses like 'processing', 'success', 'failed', etc.
